evidence: Independent 20-run focal stress produced two failures: EPERM opening the lock and one missing context entry.
requiredFix: Treat Windows EPERM, EBUSY and ENOENT around lock open/read/release as transient contention and retry until timeout; never expose them as a mutation failure while a valid lock may be transitioning.

Make stale recovery mutually exclusive. A contender must obtain a separate recovery guard or use an equivalent atomic protocol, then reread and revalidate the exact lock owner before moving/removing it. It must never move a newly-acquired lock based on stale information.
Keep owner token verification on release and initialization under the exclusive mutation lock.
Add a focused stress case for many contenders recovering a dead lock, plus 20 repeated multi-process rounds; run that test suite at least ten times independently without a failure.
scopeRule: Only file-store lock reliability and tests. LOCAL_ONLY; no package.json, network, Supabase, WhatsApp, UI, deploy or other projects.
